entry.title: Union Arab RF — my Telegram community about studying and living in Russia

link.title: Union Arab RF — my Telegram community about studying and living in Russia

entry.content:
For the past while, I’ve been running Union Arab RF — a Telegram channel where I share practical guidance about studying and living in Russia, aimed at Arabic-speaking students and newcomers navigating university life here.

Channel growth over the past month — steady, organic growth from the Arabic-speaking student community.

Why I started it

Having gone through the experience myself as an international student in Russia — from Voronezh to Moscow — I saw firsthand how little accessible, practical information exists in Arabic for students figuring out visas, university admissions, housing, and everyday life here. Union Arab RF fills that gap.

Community snapshot

Audience insights and engagement trends.

Beyond the channel

This work connects directly to what I do professionally — I work in the International Marketing and Recruitment Unit at HSE University, where I help international students navigate the same journey at scale. Running Union Arab RF keeps me close to the community on a personal level, outside of my day job.

Feel free to connect with me on LinkedIn, or join the channel: t.me/unionarabrf.
entry.summary: A behind-the-scenes look at the Telegram channel I run for Arabic-speaking students in Russia
